text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: GPU capacity exhausted in eu-west-1 inference cluster. Autoscaler failing to add GPU nodes, queue growth observed. Severity: P1.

sara: saw alerts - inference queue up 4x, many pods Pending with reason Pending: insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.

mike: looking. can anyone `kubectl get nodes -o wide`?

sara: pasted output briefly: several nodes at 0% GPU allocatable. Pending pods show: `0/0 nodes are available: 1 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu`.

taylor: checking autoscaler logs now. `kubectl logs deployment/cluster-autoscaler -n kube-system --since=1h` shows repeated errors: 
```
I1122 12:07:33.123456 1 scale_up.go:398] Failed to launch instance: UnauthorizedOperation: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
	status code: 403, request id: abcdefg
caused by: iam:PassRole denied for role arn:aws:iam::123456:role/RedwoodNodeRole
```

julia: that looks like `iam:PassRole` failing at launch template attach. could be a recent IAM policy rollout.

ops-bot: customer-impact: 27 requests/min failed with 429s on /v1/generate during spike window. Affected customers: 5 active dedicated tenants in eu-west-1.

mike: confirming: cluster-autoscaler attempted to create a nodegroup instance via launch template, got 403 when passing instance profile role. Also seen: `LaunchTemplateVersionMismatch` once.

sara: pods are queueing up - CPU-only fallback not configured for some jobs; some workloads pin to GPU.

taylor: immediate mitigation plan: 1) open temporary manual nodegroup with pre-baked instance profile (workaround to avoid PassRole), 2) scale out a small CPU fallback pool and reroute non-critical jobs, 3) notify Sales/Success about degraded SLAs.

julia: I can create the manual nodegroup. which AMI & sg? use `ami-gpu-2025-09` (preloaded drivers), sg: sg-0a1b2c3d. Use instance type p3.2xlarge for now.

mike: check quotas first? account has instance limit for p3 family: 0 currently in eu-west-1. we may need to request quota increase - that takes time.

sara: alternative: create nodegroup with g4dn.xlarge (cheaper) to get some capacity while quota request pending; adjust runtime to accept mixed GPU types.

IncidentBot: @oncall escalation to taylor in 5m.

taylor: taking pager. I'm going to try manual ASG create with existing instance profile to bypass PassRole. copying commands: 
```
aws autoscaling create-auto-scaling-group \
  --auto-scaling-group-name temp-gpu-nodes-4991 \
  --launch-configuration-name lc-gpu-4991 \
  --min-size 1 --max-size 3 --desired-capacity 2 \
  --vpc-zone-identifier subnet-aaa,subnet-bbb
```

julia: started creating LC with instance profile `arn:aws:iam::123456:instance-profile/RedwoodNodeProfile` (already attached earlier, should avoid PassRole).

mike: while that's ongoing, pushing a config change to the router to divert low-priority jobs to cpu-fallback queue: `configs/ingress -> set field priority_threshold=medium`.

sara: FYI: observed taints on a few nodes: `node.kubernetes.io/not-ready:NoSchedule` and `gpu-preempted:true:NoSchedule` - some pods evicted; need to clear taints once nodes healthy.

ops-bot: postmortem-action: flag customers impacted and open eval run to compare perf pre/post.

taylor: manual ASG creation succeeded, nodes joining cluster but one node shows `KubeletNotReady` due to mismatched NVIDIA driver kernel. I'm switching to AMI `ami-gpu-2025-09b` with matching drivers.

julia: rolling node replacement now, cordon/invalidate images on bad node: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-1-123.eu-west-1.compute.internal` then drain.

mike: router change applied, about 40% of queued jobs moved to CPU fallback, queue rate dropping to 1.2x baseline.

sara: checking app logs - tail: `Error: failed to allocate device: no compatible GPU found` persists for some flagged jobs pinned to model v3. we should add an automatic model downgrade to CPU-friendly variant for non-paid tiers.

IncidentBot: escalation update: severity remains P1. Next check-in in 15m.

taylor: handoff note for next on-call: root cause likely twofold: 1) recent IAM policy change removed `iam:PassRole` for autoscaler role during a permissions hardening rollout, 2) launch template versions mismatched (caused kernel/driver mismatch leading to NotReady taints). Immediate remediation: restore PassRole for autoscaler + ensure launchtemplate version pinning. Long-term: add preflight CI test for IAM policy changes and lock autoscaler role in a separate change window.

julia: opened ticket INF-8765 linking IAM change PR #342 and launchtemplate drift. assigning to infra-security and runtime teams.

mike: customer comms drafted, pinging @success to prepare messages for impacted tenants.

sara: monitoring shows queue back to 1.05x baseline and error rate decreasing. I will keep the manual nodegroup for 2h, then attempt safe teardown after CI-confirmed IAM fix.

ops-bot: mitigation status: manual nodegroup healthy (2/2 Ready), cpu-fallback applied, affected customers notified.

taylor: taking handoff to next shift in 30m, will leave runbook entries: 
- restore iam:PassRole to autoscaler role (with audit)
- pin launch template version for gpu nodegroups
- create small always-on buffer pool of 1-2 g4 nodes per region to avoid cold-start P1s

sara: added runbook notes and playbook `playbooks/gpu-autoscale-mitigation.md` referencing commands used.

julia: thanks team. closing immediate pager. will update INF-8765 with timeline and remediation steps. :thumbsup:
